<colloc>

<colloc> (collocate) contains a collocate of the headword.
Attributes (In addition to global attributes and those inherited from dictionaries, dictionaryParts, gramInfo)
type classifies the collocation, using any convenient typology.
Datatype: CDATA
Values: any string of characters, e.g. ‘preposition’.
Default: #IMPLIED
